rationale: The candidate reads as a compact rectilinear mass with a clearly legible central cut/void, so it supports the neighborhood-living brief better than a sealed box. The dominant gesture is coherent across the four views, and the top view confirms the carved internal figure rather than a mere bounding-box fill. The western access response appears aligned with the verified frontage by way of the open side/entry seam, giving the ground plane a public threshold instead of a sealed edge. There is some mild boxiness and the silhouette is not especially articulated in section, but the mass remains coherent and repairable. It does not collapse into an unrelated typology, and the void is programmatically meaningful enough to satisfy the active-ground and public-space invariants.
